entities.summary: Muhammad Asif Mohseni or Sheikh Asif Mohseni was famous Shia cleric and the leader of Harakat-e Islami-yi Afghanistan faction or Islamic Movement of Afghanistan. He is known for writing the infamous 2009 - Shiite Personal Status Law.
